name: yeez
description: Yeez by Clark Bros Media. The system behind a 40M-view-a-month publishing network, as a plugin: ranked headlines, sourced articles, scheduled publishing, social, newsletter and a weekly review. Works in Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor, Grok, Kimi, Hermes and OpenClaw, and publishes to WordPress, Ghost, Shopify, Wix, Webflow, HubSpot, Joomla, Framer and Blogger. Requires a Yeez license from yeez.ai.
